description: Returns an HTTP redirect to the requested album file URL. The endpoint does not inherit parent parameter declarations. If the album's `zip_allowed` flag is false, the request will return a 404 error. Malformed requests result in a 500 error. The `client_id` parameter is required for authentication.

parameters.name: client_id
parameters.description: A Client Id provided by devportal.jamendo.com.

parameters.name: audioformat
parameters.description: The audio format for the file URL. Currently only `mp3` (192kbps) is supported.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Album identifier; only a single album ID is accepted.

notes: `zip_allowed` field (returned by other album endpoints) determines whether a download is permitted; if false this endpoint returns 404.
The endpoint performs an HTTP 302 redirect to the actual file URL; no JSON body is returned.
Incorrect or missing parameters result in a 500 error with error details in the response headers.
